item.title: GTA 6 Shows Why You Should Never, Ever, Ever Text and Drive (Ever)
item.description: You can pull off a lot of heinous crimes in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Stealing a car, mugging an old lady at gunpoint, killing a bird and then beating up a cop with its corpse. All of those are sure to earn you at least a one-star Wanted level. But there’s an even worse crime in GTA 6 that you’ll probably wind up doing more than murder: texting and driving.

item.title: Brandon Sanderson’s Mistborn TTRPG Solves the Biggest Problem With Licensed Games
item.description: Licensed tabletop role-playing games provide players with a new way to experience their favorite franchises like Star Wars , Star Trek, and the Lord of the Rings . But those adventures always come with a big question about how player characters are supposed to make their mark on stories that already have their own legendary heroes. Rather than erasing canon characters or turning them into quest-givers, the wildly ambitious Mistborn Legacy campaign for the Cosmere Roleplaying Game allows players to forge legends as powerful as any of Brandon Sanderson’s characters.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Designer Reveals the Commander Trend He Wants to See More Of
item.description: While at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026, one of the trickier Magic: The Gathering Commander decks I faced was led by Maralen, Fae Ascendant , from Lorwyn Eclipsed . Currently the 40th most popular Commander, according to data from EDHREC , Maralen is a typal Commander, meaning that her abilities emphasize creature types. In this case, she’s all about two kinds of creatures rather than just one. Specifically, this is an elves and faeries Commander. Since her color identity has three colors — black, green, and blue — that gives every Maralen deck access to a wide variety of both creature types to leverage some big payoffs.

item.title: 'GTA 6' Is Triggering Men Who Are Learning How To Have A Girlfriend
item.description: Young men in relationships around the world have spent the last few weeks warning their significant others about Nov. 19. On that day, and for their forseeable future, the men in their lives would be MIA , they said. They wouldn't answer texts. They weren't going to hang out. Many women were told to accept that men would put little to no effort into their relationships for a while as they focused entirely on Grand Theft Auto 6 .

item.title: GTA 6 Players Should Change This One Setting Before Anything Else
item.description: Now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is out, players are discovering that Rockstar Games' latest feels more like Red Dead Redemption 2 than GTA 5 . Rockstar Games builds on the work it did in its open-world western and applies it to the context of a modern city. That’s a big part of why it's so successful, but that might make some players nervous. While GTA 6 moves at a quicker pace, movement can still feel a little slower than you might expect .

item.title: How to play pool in GTA 6
item.description: To play pool in Grand Theft Auto 6 , you must find a table and know the rules. You'll likely play your first game of pool during the "Coming Home" mission at the Rusty Anchor, but the game assumes some familiarity with the game of pool. Don't worry; playing pool (and winning!) is easy once you get the hang of it.

item.title: Disney Plus Reveals Official Cast for Zombie Apocalypse Reboot of Classic Comic
item.description: It's been a little over three years since Riverdale , the CW's loose adaptation of the Archie Comics characters, aired its final episode. Now Disney is gearing up to bring audiences back to the town of Riverdale, but it will be in a wildly different way. As announced this July , Disney Plus is set to release an adaptation of the horror comic Afterlife with Archie next year. Now we know who will play Archie , Betty, Veronica, and more.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino's Near-Perfect New Netflix Thriller Could Be the Next 'Knives Out'
item.description: The story behind The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth isn't quite as dramatic, but the ultimate effect is similar. Nobody died. Quentin Tarantino just made the bizarre decision that his 10th film should be his last and that a sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood wasn't going to cut it. So instead of trashing the film like he did with his last failed effort , Tarantino handed the script off to David Fincher. The result is another unusual melding of directorial styles that doesn't always work (it's definitely not the best either Fincher or Tarantino has to offer), but still manages to provide a uniquely fun time at the movies — and also on Netflix later this year.

item.title: Phone apps list in GTA 6
item.description: Phone apps in Grand Theft Auto 6 serve a purpose, but some are far more useful than others. Scooter Bros and RydeMe are among the best, whereas Snapmatic is mostly very disturbing. Nonetheless, you'd probably like to unlock them all.
